name: Biological Sciences: Genetics, Genomics and Development

rows.label: Thirteen credits of genetics, genomics and development coursework from the concentration's course areas, plus the lab options
rows.note: Counts credits from the six listed areas (genetics, genomics, development and stem cells, evolution and population genetics, molecular biology, methods) and the lab experience list. Independent research (BIOG 4990) counts for at most 3 credits and needs advisor approval, which the board cannot see (see the approval row). Courses outside the lists need approval and are not counted here.

limits.label: Independent research counts for at most 3 credits
